name: HaloITSM
summary: HaloITSM sells one all-inclusive package with no tiers: every module is included for a single per-agent price. The page we checked showed 66 pounds sterling per agent a month on annual billing, and it showed no US dollar figure. Named and concurrent licences cost the same, and a 30-day trial needs no credit card. The vendor lists ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA.

facts.text: On the pricing page, 66 pounds sterling per agent a month is shown on annual billing, with other currencies offered by region, but no US dollar price was displayed.
The page's 70-agent example shows 55,440 pounds a year before a 5% milestone discount.
An Enterprise Package offers unlimited licences and funded implementation for a fixed $1M a year.
Halo lists ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA and GDPR on its product page and links to a trust centre for detail.

plans.name: HaloITSM (all modules)
plans.notes: Shown in pounds sterling for the UK, billed annually. Named and concurrent licences are priced the same

hiddenCosts: Prices depend on the buyer's region and currency, and regions not listed need a quote.
Registered charities and NGOs get 15% off.
